lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Orlando, this is Kendra. Is this an okay time to talk?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the band exercises went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, that sounds good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your energy been this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay. The heat is getting to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What happened with the band exercises?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I did it 3 days, then the weekend happened.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again. My neighbor started doing it with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days. My daughter keeps reminding me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the band exercises going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really. Between appointments and everything, there was no time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Beans count too, and they keep you full.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What did you notice on the days it went well?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I need to get my sugar down. At least I'm trying.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That took effort.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Frozen vegetables count just as much as fresh, and they're cheaper.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can buy the frozen bags, that's easy.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Does your family eat salad?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes. I don't know where the day goes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Come on, you can find 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday. My doctor said the same thing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need this for my head too, not just my body. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I have to do something, I don't want the cancer back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the band exercises. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So what would you like your goal to be for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, I'll try to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 3 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll do it right when I wake up, before anything else.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 3 out of 5 days, the hard part was getting started, and next week you're going to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 3 days. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Oh, before you go, honestly, some days I feel like what's the point of any of this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'm really glad you told me that. A lot of people feel that way after treatment, and you don't have to carry it alone. Would it be okay if I asked our social worker to give you a call this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, that's fine.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Tuesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Kendra. Bye!

flags.reason: Participant said 'what's the point of any of this' (hopelessness). Coach did not ask about thoughts of self-harm or safety today; the social worker call was only set for 'this week'. Needs same-day risk screening and warm handoff.
'Come on, you can find 10 minutes' pushes past the participant's ambivalence ('I don't know where the day goes') without permission, which undercuts partnership.
Beans suggestion given without asking permission or linking to participant's goal, and the coach moved on at line 22 without eliciting a response.

score.summary: Kendra used good open questions and a clear summary, and set a concrete vegetable goal with a barrier plan. However, she gave advice and pushed ('Come on') despite ambivalence, and responded to the hopelessness disclosure at line 55 by referring to a social worker this week without screening for immediate safety.
strengths: Line 10 used a future-focused open question that drew out the participant's desire to 'feel like myself again'.
Line 12 and 30 emphasized the participant's autonomy over the plan.
Line 53 summarized the week and goal clearly and asked what was missed.
coaching_tips: At line 55, pause and ask directly about thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life before closing the call, and arrange a same-day contact if risk is present.
At line 35, replace 'Come on, you can find 10 minutes' with a reflection or open question about what would make 10 minutes possible.
At line 21, ask permission before offering suggestions like beans, and then ask how it fits the participant's week.
